name: glutamate ionotropic receptor NMDA type subunit 2A

function.text: GRIN2A encodes glutamate receptor ionotropic, NMDA 2A. Annotated molecular activities include NMDA glutamate receptor activity and glutamate-gated calcium ion channel activity. It participates in brain development and chemical synaptic transmission.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); Landau-Kleffner syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Colorectal Adenocarcinoma; Cholangiocarcinoma; Malignant Tumor. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
